title: Wet-Dry World
coordinateSystem: Y up; source coordinates /100; yaw degrees from +Z toward +X
routeActions: Jump from the entrance floating deck to the eastern walkway
Stand on the purple switch and cross the temporary pasta steps
Touch the raised diamond to set the water to 17.92 m
Surface-jump onto the floating platform; chain a triple jump to the tall block
Run and jump to the second block
Stand on and ride all five arrow lifts, following their pasta arrows
Jump into the saffron box and collect the star after it settles
